question.problem:
For the matrix
$P=[\begin{aligned}5 & -2 & 1 \\ 0 & 3 & 4 \\ 6 & 2 & -1\end{aligned}].$
find the minor ${M}_{12}$ of the entry ${p}_{12}.$

${M}_{12}=${{field-1}}
question.worked_solution:
The minor of ${p}_{12}=-2$ (first row, second column) is the determinant of the remaining entries when the column and row containing $-2$ are removed: 

$$
P=[\begin{aligned}∗ & -2 & ∗ \\ 0 & ∗ & 4 \\ 6 & ∗ & -1\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor of ${p}_{12}=1$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{M}_{12} & =\text{det}[\begin{aligned}0 & 4 \\ 6 & -1\end{aligned}] \\  & =|\begin{aligned}0 & 4 \\ 6 & -1\end{aligned}| \\  & =0\cdot (-1)-4\cdot 6 \\  & =0-24 \\  & =-24.\end{aligned}
$$
